# Project Guidelines

## Documentation

- For every code or configuration change, review the relevant documentation and update it in the same change so it remains accurate. This applies to bug fixes, behavior changes, new features, and internal changes covered by developer documentation.
- Update the appropriate project docs, such as `README.md`, files under `docs/`, or CLI/Web help. For new CLI or Web features, also follow the requirements in [the documentation rule](../.agents/rules/documentation.md).
- If no documentation needs changing, explain briefly in the final response why the change does not affect documented behavior or development guidance.
